issue: Retention of passenger words and media in logs
implemented_mitigation: Event log stores decision, route, ids, scores, band, flags, latency only; no image, audio or transcript fields; application never copies or saves uploads
residual_risk: Escalation note kept verbatim (≤500 chars) in tickets.jsonl; thumbnail and transcript held in session state; Gradio temp files and platform logs not controlled by the project
future_improvement: Redact/filter the note; document retention and add a deletion routine; assess platform temp-file handling

issue: Sensitive content in uploaded photos (boarding passes
residual_risk: No OCR; no text is read from images; image is embedded by CLIP and compared with prompts, not stored by the app
future_improvement: src/vision.py (no text-recognition path); configs/settings.py enable_ocr=False; captures show only category/record evidence
column6: Whole frame still uploaded and embedded; thumbnail persists in the session panel; no content detection or redaction
column7: Privacy notice and consent step before upload; on-device downscale/crop; face/text-region blurring before embedding

implemented_mitigation: Audio not stored by the app; transcript not logged; no speaker identification
evidence: src/event_log.py docstring and fields; src/speech.py (transcribe only)
residual_risk: Spoken names/references are transcribed, displayed and searched; audio passes through server; no redaction
future_improvement: Consent step for voice; transcript redaction of identifier-like tokens not needed for retrieval; local ASR option

evidence: Duration/loudness gate; editable transcript ('You said — edit if this is wrong'); wrong transcripts fall into the same clarify/abstain policy
residual_risk: Blind v3 speech WER 0.015 on 6 clips; preprocessing evidence aud_121 mis-transcribed at −40.6 dBFS; dataset 120/125 TTS, 1 human speaker, all quiet/clean
future_improvement: No accent, noise, age or disability evaluation performed; gate is a floor not a normaliser; nothing detects a wrong transcript
column6: Consented multi-speaker multi-accent recordings with terminal noise; per-group WER; expose an ASR confidence signal

issue: Vision generalisation from clean pictograms to real signage
implemented_mitigation: Vision thresholds τ_high 0.30 / τ_low 0.24 / margin 0.015; out-of-scope anchors; blur/dark/bright flags shown; scores labelled as similarities not probabilities
evidence: data_exploration: 64 clean icons vs 37 photos, 19 dev positives, no images for security/accessibility prompts; Blind v3: top-1 5/6, in-scope outcome 3/6, OOS 2/2, wrong-confident 0
residual_risk: Photographed/angled/blurred signs often end in clarification; two prompt categories never validated on images; real airport signage untested
future_improvement: Add photographed and multilingual signage incl. security/accessibility examples; study glare and angle; re-set thresholds on a larger dev split

implemented_mitigation: Whisper forced to English transcription; English vocabulary, gazetteers and exemplars; non-English queries expected to abstain
evidence: src/speech.py::transcribe generate_kwargs; data/vocabulary.json; queries_*.csv non_english rows
residual_risk: Non-English-speaking passengers excluded from text and voice paths; non-English speech rendered as best-effort English
future_improvement: Language detection; per-language normalisation and vocabularies; translated KB fields

implemented_mitigation: Deterministic-first cascade; text thresholds 0.50/0.25/margin 0.10 with intent floors; clarify/abstain below thresholds; evidence panel with route, record, band and raw scores
evidence: configs/settings.py; src/retrieval.py::decide; captures A–E evidence panels; Blind v3 safe-outcome 0.90, wrong-confident image answers 0
residual_risk: Blind v3: 2 wrong-confident text answers (identifier overriding requested service); explanation wording sometimes lags the decision (structured deployment scenarios 4 and 5)
future_improvement: Prefer the more specific abstention reason; derive evidence wording from the narrowed candidate set; revisit identifier-vs-service precedence

implemented_mitigation: Router rule R4 surfaces a strong image of another category as a conflict ('Inputs disagree'); nothing is averaged
evidence: src/router.py rule order; Blind v3 conflict precision 1.00
residual_risk: Blind v3 conflict recall 0.50: an uncertain image is ignored rather than counted as disagreement
future_improvement: Treat an uncertain image whose top category differs from the text as a soft conflict to be confirmed

evidence: Volatile redirect before any lookup ('I do not hold live flight, gate or delay information.' + availability note); live-status sentence pointing to terminal displays; hours shown without asserting open/closed
residual_risk: src/retrieval.py volatile branch; src/responses.py::render; captured 'I cannot see the current time' sentence (deployment smoke-test session)
future_improvement: Some live-gate phrasings miss the redirect (Blind v3 known limitation); no live data source exists, so a passenger relying on the KB for anything time-critical is exposed
column6: Live-data adapter behind the existing redirect policy; broaden volatile phrasing detection

implemented_mitigation: 'Request assistance' writes a reference record and names a KB contact route; message states the assistant cannot connect to a person; scope note says 'not a live agent'
evidence: app/app.py::request_assistance; src/event_log.py::open_ticket; SCOPE_NOTE; captured UI text
residual_risk: No real staff receive the record; on the Space the tickets file is ephemeral, so a quoted reference may not survive a restart
future_improvement: Real escalation endpoint to airport staff; durable ticket store with retention policy
